subject: Post-demo: budget fit validation & token-econ summary
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ella Thompson <ella@novafarm.com>, Novafarm Procurement <procurement@novafarm.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: budget fit validation & token-econ summary

Hi Ella / procurement team —

Thanks for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a clear ask to keep momentum:

What we heard on the call
- Expected steady-state inference: ~1.0–1.5M tokens / month (peak bursts up to 3M).
- Evaluation focus: hallucination rate on structured outputs + inference latency target < 300ms P95.
- Procurement note: standard PO threshold is $20k/month; anything above requires PO + SOW.

Redwood's initial pricing / consumption profile for Novafarm (hosted + pilot discount):
- Baseline list: $1,000 per 1M tokens (text gen + chat mix).
- Pilot discount (term-limited): targeting $600–700 per 1M tokens for a 3-month pilot with 1M committed monthly.
- Dedicated / reserved pricing (if you reserve capacity): can drop to ~$450 per 1M tokens depending on commit and quantization profile.

Attached I dropped a simple spend scenarios workbook (Novafarm_Spend_Scenarios.xlsx) that models: low/expected/high consumption and the implied monthly bill under list vs pilot discount vs reserved. Summary rows: monthly band assumptions and when procurement / PO kicks in.

Ask / next steps
1) Can you confirm the procurement PO threshold that triggers a formal contract + SOW? We heard $20k/month on the call but want that in writing for the pricing path.
2) Can you confirm the expected committed band you’d be comfortable with for a pilot (options in the workbook: 0.5M, 1M, 2M monthly)?
3) If procurement needs SOC2 / evidence, I attached a stub and linked full artifacts in Drive; legal can review.

If you confirm PO threshold and pick a pilot band, I’ll: (a) send a short pilot pricing addendum, (b) create a one-page mutual action plan with milestones and success metrics, and (c) provision a dedicated test pool.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow to run the workbook together.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

[Attachment: Novafarm_Spend_Scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: RNW_Proposal_Novafarm_20260830.pdf (proposal)]

From: Ella Thompson <ella@novafarm.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Novafarm Procurement <procurement@novafarm.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: budget fit validation & token-econ summary

Thanks Jordan — useful summary. A few clarifications from our end:

- Procurement confirms the PO threshold: any commitment >= $20,000 / month requires a PO and routed legal review. Anything below can be handled on a standard SaaS order form.
- Our current internal guardrail for pilots is to keep spend under $25k over 3 months unless legal signs off on data processing addenda.
- Expected production ramp: we’re forecasting ~1.2M tokens / month after pilot; peak seasonal traffic could push to 2.8–3M in bursts.

Procurement follow-ups
- Please share SOC2 report link and a contact for security review (I forwarded to security@novafarm.com).
- We prefer a simple pilot addendum (term, committed band, pilot discount, auto-convert option). If you can draft that we’ll attach it to the PO when we’re over the threshold.

We’ll take a look at the workbook and aim to pick a pilot band by EOD Wednesday.

— Ella
Ella Thompson
Product Lead, Platform Integrations | Novafarm
ella@novafarm.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ella Thompson <ella@novafarm.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Novafarm Procurement <procurement@novafarm.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: budget fit validation & token-econ summary

Appreciate the quick clarifications, Ella — that aligns with what we heard. A couple of notes based on procurement thresholds and your ramp:

1) Pilot recommendation: 1M committed / month with a $650 per 1M token pilot price (3-month term). That keeps the first-month invoice below the $20k PO threshold (est. $650), but we’ll surface the 3-month total for PO consideration.
2) If you want scaled protection on unit economics during ramp, we can add a capped overage rate: list price for excess tokens but with a monthly cap to avoid surprise bills.
3) SOC2 link: https://drive.redwood.com/novafarm/security/SOC2-RNW-2026.pdf (full artifact). I also attached the short proposal PDF with the pilot terms and two commit options (0.5M / 1M).

Next steps from Redwood
- I’ll upload a one-page pilot addendum + mutual action plan to the Drive and share the link here by EOD.
- Vanessa, can you confirm whether we can approve the 1M @ $650 pilot price for RNW-4931 (3-month trial) or do we need finance signoff?

If you prefer, I can convert the Drive artifacts into a DocuSign bundle once the band is selected.

— Jordan
[Attachment: RNW_Proposal_Novafarm_20260830.pdf (proposal)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo: budget fit validation & token-econ summary (internal)

Quick internal — we can approve 1M @ $650 for a time-limited pilot (3 months) but with the following constraints:
- Deal must include automatic reporting cadence + token spike alerting; no unexpected egress or add-on charges during the pilot.
- If Novafarm signals intent to convert to Dedicated/reserved, finance wants an early forecast (monthly expected tokens) so we can surface tiered pricing to them.
- Legal: we’ll only include the auto-convert clause if procurement confirms they can sign a PO for the conversion amount.

Jordan — go ahead and send the pilot addendum draft and M.A.P. I’ll loop in finance if Ella picks the convert option.

— Karthik
Head of Pricing & GTM Economics | Redwood Inference
